content.value: . Following figure showns a turbine drives pump that provides water to a mixing chamber located at 25 m height than the pump. Steady state operating data for the turbine and pump are labeled on the figure. Heat transfer from the water to its surroundings occurs at a rate of 2 kW. For the turbine, heat transfer with the surroundings and potential energy effects are negligible. Kinetic energy effects at all numbered states can be ignored. Determine: (i) the power required by the pump in kW to supply the water to the inlet of the mixing chamber.
(ii) the mass flow rate of steam in kg/s that flows through the turbine.
